## Why This Is Asked
Tests real-world design of GPU-accelerated inference, data residency, and governance in Azure.

## Key Concepts
- GPU inference on AKS with Nvidia GPUs
- MongoDB Atlas Change Streams to Event Hubs
- Azure ML model registry and deployment
- Per-tenant isolation with RBAC and Purview
- BYOK with Key Vault; data residency controls
- DR to paired region; cost governance with per-tenant autoscale budgets

## Code Example
```javascript
// Kubernetes manifest snippet for GPU deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: fraud-inference
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: score
        image: myregistry.azurecr.io/fraud-score:latest
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
            cpu: "2"
            memory: "8Gi"
```
